scope: Read-only diagnosis of the eight completed r=1, rank10, seed2 formal runs
indexing: task, batch, step_index are zero-based; epoch is one-based. Epoch accuracy is online current-task training accuracy at phi0, not an end-of-epoch test evaluation.
findings: All four collapsed cells first learn Task0, then lose it during Task0 training. This is a within-task optimization failure already before later-task forgetting.
The sign-product split is descriptive: successful cells have second_probe_sign*second_difference_sign=+1; collapsed cells have product=-1.
Every actual third probe satisfies its requested sign and every SGD update is independently guarded to equal base-lr*U. The original CE gradient is not globally negated.

Finite CE, gradient, residual, and natural-update spikes occur before or during collapse. Negative U·g0 events are sparse and do not precede every collapse; persistent ascent at phi0 is not an adequate explanation.

Natural update magnitudes differ greatly after paths diverge; these runs do not separate direction from amplitude. Residual/anchor ratio >1 also occurs in successful cells, so that threshold alone is not sufficient.
No Hessian spectrum, directional curvature, or post-update local loss measurement establishes a causal anti-flatness mechanism in these traces.

code_audit.formula: g0=grad CE(phi0); phi1=phi0+rho*g0/(normg0+eps); g1=grad CE(phi1); phi2=phi0+r*(g1-g0)/(norm(g1-g0)+eps); g2=grad CE(phi2); phi3=phi2+s*rho*g2/(normg2+eps); g3=grad CE(phi3); U=anchor+c*(g3-g2); actual phi_new=phi0-lr*U
facts: torch.autograd.grad on finite positive CE, no explicit negative loss
All trainable LoRA and classifier parameters are covered; delta-gradient hooks rejected
Base, buffers, modes and RNG restored before assignment of p.grad=U
torch.optim.SGD has momentum=0, weight_decay=0, dampening=0, nesterov=False, maximize=False
Exact tensor comparison checks applied parameters against base-lr*U
Sign and formula identities independently checked with scalar norm/cosine relations from every trace row
